fact: As of November 2018, School-Link, an EDUPAC integrated school management system with a Learner Unit Record Information and Tracking System and learner absenteeism module, approved by the Ministry of Education, Arts and Culture in 2013 as the national system for all schools and free to them, connected 807 public schools of 1,848 schools in Namibia; most schools still used paper attendance registers, and a 103-school pilot funded by ADEA captured daily learner attendance in School-Link from May to July 2018.
title: Project Implementation Report: Innovations for Monitoring Teacher and Learner Attendances - Namibia Pilot Project
publisher: Ministry of Education, Arts & Culture, Republic of Namibia / ADEA
